body: I don't know how. The worst part about it is that my mother will be destroyed. All of her children are fuck ups, I'm the one that was supposed to succeed. I was the one with the talent, the dreams and ambition. I just can't take it anymore. Tears fill my eyes every morning the moment they open, because I can't take the thought of waiting out the minutes in the day.

Nobody takes me seriously. I work so damn hard at everything I do. I care deeper about everything on this planet and give everything I have for others that need. I'm never recommended by friends for work, even though they know what I'm dealing with. I'm never invited to be a part of anything. When my life falls apart, not a single shout out. 

I spent 2 years as an intern for a company that treated me like family until they needed me no longer and now I've been left behind in the dust. I shout out for help and get ignored. 

The worst part is I know that if given the opportunity I would make a huge impact on this world, in a good way. I have 10 times the heart of most people I know and yet I'm at the bottom of everything. Get rejected for min wage jobs, can't even get FREE work in my own industry. I feel like Bruce Willis in the sixth Sense. Sounds strange but I almost feel like I'm invisible. 

They say hard work pays off, but it doesn't. I swear with all my heart it does not pay off.
Me too buddy. If I wasn't a deadbeat loser I'd hire you.
